transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because... I don’t know, nothing feels like mine anymore. Things I used to care about—murals, going for runs, playing basketball, even making a good drink at work—I just kind of stand there now like I don’t care about any of it.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About two months now. It started after the bar got bought out and all the stuff I’d been working toward there just... changed.
Do you still enjoy things that you used to find pleasurable, or has the pleasure gone away as well?

Yeah, the pleasure’s pretty much gone. I used to actually look forward to things—painting murals, going for a run, playing ball, even making a drink well at work. Now I just kind of go through the motions, like none of it means much to me.
Do you feel sad most of the time?
I’m not sure I’d call it sad all the time. It’s more like I feel flat, kind of empty. Some days I do feel down, yeah, but mostly it’s just... nothing feels right.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in or enjoy doing?

Not really. I used to get excited about painting murals, going for a run, playing basketball, even making a good drink at the bar. Now I just kind of stand there like I don’t care about any of it. Nothing feels like mine anymore.
Have you had any thoughts of hurting yourself?
I don’t really know. I mean… I haven’t made any plans or anything. Sometimes I just get tired of feeling like this, but I’m not sure I’d say I want to hurt myself.
Have you noticed any change in your weight recently?

Yeah… I think so. I haven’t really been eating much. Most days I forget to eat until my hands start shaking at work, then after closing I’ll grab a few bites of something cold, but even looking at it kind of makes me feel sick.
Do you feel like you're moving slower than usual or have trouble sitting still?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed myself pacing or anything like that. Maybe I’m a little slower sometimes, but I can’t really tell.
Do you often feel guilty or worthless about things?

Yeah. A lot. I keep thinking I let people down… the younger bartenders, and some artists I told I’d make space for. It feels like I wrecked their chance, and… like I deserve whatever comes to me for that.
Do you feel like you're moving slower than you used to?
I don’t really know. I haven’t been paying much attention to how I move. Maybe I’m dragging a bit, but I can’t say for sure.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight over the past two months?

I don’t know the exact number, but I probably have. Most days I just forget to eat until my hands start shaking at work. Then after closing I’ll force down a few bites of something cold, but even looking at food kind of makes me feel sick.
Do you feel like you're resting or sleeping more than usual?
No, not more. I’m tired, but when I lie down my head just keeps going over every mistake I made at work. If I do fall asleep, I usually wake up around four or five and then I can’t get back to sleep.
Do you find yourself fidgeting or feeling restless?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think I’m fidgeting more than normal. I feel uneasy a lot, but I haven’t noticed myself pacing or anything like that.
Do you find yourself feeling restless or unable to sit still?
I don’t think so. I feel on edge sometimes, but I’m not really unable to sit still or moving around all the time.
Do you find yourself feeling like you need to move around or do something to get rid of this uneasy feeling?
Not really, no. I feel uneasy, but I don’t feel like I have to get up and move around to make it stop.
Do you feel like you're fidgeting or having trouble keeping still when you're sitting or lying down?
Not really. When I’m sitting or lying down, I don’t think I’m fidgeting or having trouble keeping still. I’m just… uneasy sometimes, but I haven’t noticed that kind of thing.
Do you find yourself unintentionally repeating certain movements, like tapping your hands or feet?
No, I haven’t noticed myself doing that. I don’t think I’m tapping my hands or feet over and over without meaning to.
Do you feel like you have been more restless than usual?
I don’t think so. I mean, I feel uneasy at times, but I wouldn’t say I’ve been more restless than usual.
Do you feel like you've been more fidgety than usual?
I don’t think so. I mean, I haven’t really noticed being more fidgety than usual.
Do you think you've been speaking more slowly than usual?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed myself talking slower, but maybe someone else would pick up on that more than me.
